'''Dead Blood Fluid''' is a liquid material.

==''Obtainment''==
*Collection via a [[Dead Blood]] source block with Glass Bottles.
*Brewing a [[Diseased Sponge]] with an Awkward Potion(s).

==''Usage''==
Dead Blood Fluid can be consumed, which it will apply [[Viral|Viral II]] for thirty seconds and visibly distort the screen.<ref>The screen distortion is not an actual "effect" and cannot be removed by Milk. It can be toggled with the "/srp_breathe" command.</ref> Other than this, it can be combined in the [[Metallurgical Infuser Furnace|Infuser Furnace]] with Iron Ingots to create [[Semi-organic Ingot|Semi-organic Ingots]] and Infested Sand to create Infested Glass.

It can also be used to craft the [[Phase Module]].
